description: HELD-OUT-3: fresh conceptual --for questions authored from source after the TUNE, HELD and HELD-OUT-2 splits were fixed; never used for tuning. Covers orchestration questions (a coordinator that decides, schedules or publishes versus its leaf helpers) and policy/data questions (exported arrays of names or patterns plus the predicates around them). Same labels and metrics as retrieval-eval.json. Repos are read from retrieval-eval.json.

questions.query: run one review from input load through discovery to coordinated findings
questions.question: When a review run starts, how do the discovery stage and the coordinator run in order, and which function ties them together?

questions.query: decide whether a pull request review should start or be skipped as duplicate
questions.question: Before reviewers run, what decides that a pull request is already reviewed at this head and should be skipped?

questions.query: book overnight port for confirmed lines when no device order is open
questions.question: When mobile lines are confirmed and no device order is still shipping, who books the overnight number port and with which schedule?

questions.query: fan out reviewer instances per agent during discovery
questions.question: How many reviewer instances does each agent get in discovery, and which stage launches them?

questions.query: keep git metadata dotenv files and private key files away from the reviewer
questions.question: Which repository paths must never be shown to the review model, such as version-control internals, environment files, and private keys?

questions.query: hard caps on changed files findings and review time per run
questions.question: What hard limits bound the number of changed files, the findings per agent, and the total review time?

questions.query: which carrier names share a transfer kind on each network
questions.question: Which source carriers are treated as the same billing-transfer family on AT&T and on T-Mobile, and how is the transfer kind chosen?

questions.query: lazy page download failed so reload once after deploy
questions.question: Which error messages mean a lazily loaded page file failed to download, so the app should reload instead of showing a crash?

questions.query: employers exempt from the financed device limit
questions.question: Which access codes or employers may finance phones past the account limit, and how is that exemption applied to the over-limit count?

questions.query: tracking parameters kept from the landing link across login
questions.question: Which campaign tracking parameters are captured from the landing URL and kept for the session, even after login sends the member to a deep link?

questions.query: evidence quote must appear in the reviewed file before a finding is kept
questions.question: What checks that a finding's quoted evidence really exists in the changed file before the finding is accepted?

questions.query: when is a pull request too large or its diff incomplete for AI review
questions.question: What measures decide that a pull request is too large or incompletely fetched for an AI review, and what is the check run titled when it is rejected?

questions.query: port window hour for the date a member picked
questions.question: Given the date and window a member picked for the port, what local time is the scheduled port sent to the carrier?
